# A USD receivable, settled with the money arriving as CAD.
#
# The receivable opened a 100.00 USD basis at 1.40 when it was written. The
# customer then pays and the bank takes CAD, so the settling credit is a
# receivable split against its normal direction with no foreign-currency split
# beside it — which is, line for line, the shape of a prepayment that arrives
# converted (fx_prepayment_arriving_as_cad.txt). The one difference is the
# lot: a prepayment names its owner and belongs to a lot no invoice owns,
# while these two hand-written splits belong to no lot at all.
#
# What this fixture produces: `fx-balances` lists one basis, the receivable's
# own 100.00 USD at 1.40 CAD/USD. Treating every lot-less credit as a
# prepayment would list the settlement as a second basis and offer 200.00 USD
# from a book that holds none — the currency came in once and left once.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-15 * "Write a 100 USD receivable at 1.40"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "140.00"
	Income:Sales -140.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-140.00"

2026-02-01 * "Customer settles, the money arriving as CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 137.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "137.00"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "-137.00"
